_comment: Accepted definite violations (accessibility-checker-engine, WCAG_2_2) for scripts/a11y-cls-gate.mjs. id is "<route>:<rule>", "<route>@<width>:<rule>" or "*:<rule>". Each entry needs a reason; remove it once fixed so the gate blocks regressions.

accepted.reason: Pre-existing, site-wide header: the logo (src/components/brand/Logo.tsx) sits in the same link as the visible "Revora" wordmark, so screen readers read the name twice. Fix: alt="" on the mark when the wordmark is shown.

Pre-existing, phone widths: the mobile menu button (src/components/marketing/Chrome.tsx) always sets aria-controls="marketing-mobile-menu", but that element is only rendered while the menu is open. Fix: render the menu container always (hidden) or set aria-controls only when open.

Pre-existing (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name): VoiceDictateButton.tsx shows "Say it" but its aria-label is "Dictate <field>", so a voice-control user saying the visible text can't activate it. Fix: aria-label that starts with the visible text, e.g. "Say it: <field>".

Likely engine false positive: the home Before/After slider (BeforeAfterSlider.tsx RevoraStyleSide, aria-hidden decorative mockup) draws #f5f3ee text on its own dark INK layer, but the engine measures it against the stacked light 'before' layer and reports 1.07:1. Needs a manual check; narrow or remove once confirmed.
